description: This Java class defines the Content entity for the sales management system, including fields for descriptions, merchant store, visibility, content position, type, and order, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class representing content with descriptions, merchant association, visibility, position, type, and order, mapped to the CONTENT table with JPA annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the content.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the content is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the first content description if available.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the content.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the content.

methods.name: getContentPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of the content.

methods.name: setContentPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the content.
